title: Quantik engine response v1
description: JSON response body for an engine service's chosen move (engine-response.v1). The optional fields are the union of what the Rust API (value) and the Python play service (value, policy) emit today.

value.description: Optional position evaluation. Perspective and scale are implementation-defined in v1 (see docs).

policy.description: Optional 64-slot action-indexed prior; slot i is action i.
